title: AcceptanceCriteria
description: What counts as delivered, fixed before a deal opens. An Agreement names one of these by `acceptance_criteria_id`, so the standard a delivery is judged against is chosen at funding time rather than argued afterwards. `evidence_required` lists the artefacts the seller's EvidenceEnvelope must carry, and `auto_release_threshold` states the condition that settles the deal without anyone disputing it ('all_tests_pass' in the reference example).

artifact_path.description: For schema_validity, the committed POSIX-relative delivered file to validate.

schema_hash.description: SHA-256 of the repository schema bytes named by schema_or_test_ref.

repo_commit_hash.description: Exact Git revision whose verifier implementation is authorized.

runtime_hash.description: SHA-256 of the authorized package-lock.json runtime dependency graph.
